per_item.F1: fixed as Addition 2 says. deleteUnusedInvitesOf (org-store.js:138) is one constant statement 'delete from invites where email_norm = $1 and used_at is null and ($2::uuid is null or id <> $2::uuid)'. In deleteAccount (orgs.js:386) it runs with the target's email_norm, which lockUserForDelete now selects under the row lock (org-store.js:239) BEFORE anonymiseUser changes it, after scrubInviteEmails and before the purge and the audit row, all in the one platform transaction. In acceptInvite (orgs.js:276) it runs after the claim, the user, consent, membership and setInviteUsedBy, with the used invite's id as the exception, before the audit row, in the same transaction. Probes (sp12): three invites for one address, accepting one leaves only the used one; the other two old codes answer 404 for view and accept; an invite of another address is untouched; after the deletion of that account an unused invite planted for the address is gone, no invite row holds the address (the used one holds the placeholder), the planted code answers 404 and cannot create the account again; a deletion failing at the audit step rolls everything back (user still active, the unused invite still there); an acceptance failing at the audit step deletes nothing (both invites still unused, no user). My pass-1 probe sp10 now passes (the second invite is 404 after the deletion).
per_item.F2: fixed: services/projects.js:275-277 returns {id: null, name: null, platform: true} for a version whose author is the platform admin; other authors keep id and name; the admin's card (N8) is unchanged. Probe: the N13 answer holds neither the admin's user id nor his name anywhere in its text, members' own authors are unchanged, and the admin card still shows the real author with the admin flag.
per_item.F4: fixed: purgeOrg (project-store.js:237-239) reads the organisation's kind with one constant statement after the platform-settings check and before the purge setting is set, and throws a TypeError for kind owner with no delete. Probe: the owner organisation's project and version stay after a purge attempt (TypeError); a purge under tenant settings is still refused; a customer organisation still purges (3 versions, 1 project) and app.purge_org is empty afterwards; an unknown organisation id is a no-op.
per_item.nothing_else: No other code line changed: the diff of the four files holds only these changes; no check, refusal, limit or grant was removed or loosened; the new statements are constants with bound parameters (Q9). F3 stays a recorded LOW defect as decisions/0138 Addition 2 says.
